prespecification_note: Written and checksum-pinned before the model was evaluated at the Ogawa sampling times or any non-compartmental emulation was run. Not blinded: from the parameters alone it was already known that the model's single-dose AUC from zero to infinity at 1.3 mg/m2 is 1.3/9.2 mg.h/L (about 141 ng.h/mL), that its terminal half-life is about 98 h, and that its single clearance (about 15 L/h at 1.62 m2) lies between Ogawa's day 1 (52 L/h) and day 11 (12 L/h) values. No emulated NCA value had been computed.
not_this: Not validation or qualification of the PK model; no acceptance limits are introduced.
Not a comparison of individual concentrations; only Table 3 means and SDs are available (Figure 1a was not digitised).
Not a test of the platelet model.
Not a dosing or exposure prediction for any patient.
question: When the Lignet 2022 PK model is sampled at the Ogawa 2008 times and analysed the way Ogawa analysed patient data, does it reproduce the reported day 1 and day 11 exposure in Japanese patients, and the rise in exposure from day 1 to day 11?

data.model: intelligence_store/bortezomib_pk.py (exact three-compartment solution; Lignet 2022 Table 1 per-m2 parameters)

simulation.regimen: IV bolus of the dose level (0.7, 1.0 or 1.3 mg/m2) at t = 0, 72, 168 and 240 h (days 1, 4, 8, 11).
simulation.body_size: Not needed: dose and all volumes and clearances are per m2, so concentrations do not depend on BSA.
simulation.day1_profile: Model total concentration at 0.0833, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 12, 24 and 48 h after t = 0.
simulation.day11_profile: Model total concentration at the same times after t = 240 h, including drug remaining from the doses on days 1, 4 and 8 (as a measured day 11 profile would).

nca_emulation.c0: Log-linear back-extrapolation to the dose time from the first two samples (5 and 15 min).
nca_emulation.auc_to_last: Trapezoidal rule from the dose time (concentration C0) through the 48 h sample.
nca_emulation.terminal_rate: Log-linear least-squares slope over the last points.
nca_emulation.auc_to_infinity: AUC to 48 h plus C(48 h) divided by the terminal rate.
nca_emulation.why_readings: Ogawa does not state the software, AUC rule or which points defined the terminal phase. The primary reading is the common default (linear trapezoidal; last three points: 12, 24 and 48 h).

descriptive: model AUC to infinity without emulation (true model exposure), for context

comparison.interval: 95% confidence interval of the observed mean: mean +/- t(0.975, n - 1) x SD / sqrt(n).

classification.consistent: Emulated model value inside the interval.

comparison.also_reported: Ratio emulated model / observed mean for every endpoint.
comparison.robustness: Each endpoint is classified under all four NCA readings; the result is called robust if all four agree.

decision_rule.summary: The PK component is recorded as externally consistent at a dose level only if all three primary endpoints are consistent under the primary reading. Otherwise the endpoints that are not consistent are recorded as findings.
decision_rule.never: No parameter is re-estimated or tuned. The model is not changed by this check.

known_differences: The model is a typical-value (median-like) model; the observed values are arithmetic means of skewed quantities, which tend to exceed the typical value.
Day 11 n = 5 and day 1 n = 7 at 1.3 mg/m2 are not the same patients for every value; the reported AUC ratio is a mean of per-patient ratios.
The model was built from pediatric parameters scaled to adults (Hanley 2017) and has one clearance; the label and Ogawa both report lower clearance after repeated doses.
Japanese patients may differ in body size and other covariates; per-m2 dosing removes BSA from concentrations but not other differences.
The analysis software and options of the source are not stated; the four readings bracket the usual choices.
